selection_model.selection_note: Pick 1-2 dominant packs per show and inject one contrast pack for tension windows.

packs.name: Beam Lanes
packs.focus: Clean architectural lanes with readable direction reversals.
mover_ideas: Hold movers in 2-3 lane families and reverse every 8 bars.
Mirror opposing lanes on phrase boundaries for clear architecture.
Expand lane width only at major drop entries.
par_ideas: Run lane-matched 1b or 2b chase during energy moments.
Inject beat-1 phrase marker flashes every 4 bars.
Reset to 4-beat fade after high-density windows.
anti_rules: Do not scatter movers across unrelated targets in the same bar.
Avoid long strobe blocks without recovery bars.

packs.name: Accent Tokens
packs.focus: Precise phrase punctuation over stable base motion.
mover_ideas: Keep a stable 4-beat mover route and inject one-beat punctuation hits.
Use phrase-start accents as repeatable tokens for recognition.
Reserve full route swaps for section boundaries.
par_ideas: Run 2-beat chase in groove bars and compress to 1-beat on accents.
Use a phrase marker hit on beat 1 for structural clarity.
Alternate chase and fade bars to keep tokens special.
anti_rules: Do not fire accent tokens every bar.
Avoid changing both color world and geometry on every accent.

packs.name: Leader Follower Swap
packs.focus: Intentional fixture hierarchy with controlled role swaps.
mover_ideas: Assign one mover family as leader for 4 bars, then handoff.
Use phase-shifted follower paths to preserve hierarchy.
Swap leader role only at phrase boundaries.
par_ideas: PAR chase follows leader in unison blocks.
Follower bars use counterpoint chase direction.
Use 4-beat fades in transitional handoff bars.
anti_rules: Do not run all fixtures as co-leads for long spans.
Avoid random leader swaps inside the same phrase.

packs.name: Punctuation Windows
packs.focus: Short burst windows around structural punctuation.
mover_ideas: Maintain steady route flow outside punctuation windows.
Trigger one-bar snap burst windows before and after drops.
Return to groove trajectory immediately after punctuation.
par_ideas: Shift fade->chase only during 1-2 bar punctuation windows.
Use dense 1-beat chase inside windows and reset to 2/4-beat after.
Phrase-end bars should resolve with reduced chase density.
anti_rules: Do not leave burst mode active for full sections.
Avoid stacking strobes and inclusion effects for more than 2 bars.

packs.name: Object Orbit
packs.focus: Geometry-first orbit around a virtual stage object.
mover_ideas: Anchor routes around one object target per section (DJ/center/ceiling).
Use mirror and phase-shift to build orbital layers.
Expand orbit radius only in climax phrases.
par_ideas: Pair PAR ring chase with orbit direction.
Invert ring direction during contrast windows.
Use 4-beat fade orbit breath in intros and breakdowns.
anti_rules: Do not jump orbit anchor points every bar.
Avoid mixing unrelated orbit centers in one phrase.

packs.name: Density Cycle
packs.focus: Simple -> medium -> dense -> release pacing loops.
mover_ideas: Keep base routes simple, then add transform layers in stages.
Peak density should last only 4-8 bars before release.
Use release bars with reduced transform count.
par_ideas: Cycle chase timing 4b -> 2b -> 1b -> fade reset.
Use release bars with long fade and low chase activity.
Keep dense chase packets tied to phrase peaks.
anti_rules: Do not keep maximum density active across entire songs.
Avoid release bars with aggressive chase/strobe carryover.

packs.name: Thesis Discipline
packs.focus: Single visual language with controlled variation.
mover_ideas: Stay inside one geometry family for full show coherence.
Use transform changes instead of route family jumps.
Reserve one secondary geometry only for contrast markers.
par_ideas: Keep chase topology stable within each phrase bucket.
Change chase topology only at phrase boundaries.
Use fade bars to reset before major topology shifts.
anti_rules: Do not mix many unrelated chase topologies in one section.
Avoid random geometry flips without phrase context.

packs.name: Modular Blocks
packs.focus: Robust reusable cue modules with deterministic chaining.
mover_ideas: Build 4-bar mover modules and chain them per phrase.
Use module A/B alternation for long-form variation.
Fallback to neutral module at transitions.
par_ideas: Run relay chase blocks synchronized to module boundaries.
Use 2-beat chase by default, 1-beat only in climax modules.
Insert fade reset module every third dense block.
anti_rules: Do not create fragile one-off blocks with no fallback.
Avoid dense module chaining without reset bars.

packs.name: Narrative Sweep
packs.focus: Wide-to-tight narrative travel across sections.
mover_ideas: Start wide perimeter sweeps, then collapse to center focus.
Use inverse collapse in emotional release phrases.
Tie sweep width changes to phrase transitions.
par_ideas: Perimeter chase during wide phases.
Center-weighted chase during tight phases.
Use 4-beat fades while reshaping spatial focus.
anti_rules: Do not collapse and expand every bar.
Avoid spatial focus moves that conflict with phrase direction.

packs.name: High Low Alternation
packs.focus: Playful alternating planes and intensity depth.
mover_ideas: Alternate high-plane and low-plane route ownership by bar.
Use parity logic (odd/even bars) for predictable playfulness.
Reverse plane ownership at phrase boundaries.
par_ideas: Alternate blink/fade behavior by bar parity.
Use low-plane bars for 2-beat chase and high-plane bars for 1-beat hits.
Insert fade breath bars every 8 bars.
anti_rules: Do not stack high and low peaks in the same beat continuously.
Avoid parity patterns that drift off phrase grid.

packs.name: Lift Ladder
packs.focus: Multi-bar lift ladders before peak moments.
mover_ideas: Increase tilt/height in ladder steps every 2 bars.
Add transform complexity as ladder climbs.
Resolve ladder on drop with clear geometry reset.
par_ideas: Compress chase timing 4b -> 2b -> 1b through the lift.
Use beat-1 punctuation on ladder steps.
Immediately release to calmer chase after peak punctuation.
anti_rules: Do not skip ladder progression steps before drops.
Avoid endless 1-beat chase after ladder completion.

packs.name: Atmospheric Weave
packs.focus: Textural movement and emotional transitions.
mover_ideas: Use slow canopy sweeps and soft cross-weaves.
Keep transforms subtle and low-frequency in emotional sections.
Introduce one high-contrast transform only near phrase exits.
par_ideas: Favor 4-beat and 8-beat fade worlds in low-energy phrases.
Add sparse chase punctuation at transition points.
Keep chase density restrained during atmospheric arcs.
anti_rules: Do not over-strobe in atmospheric sections.
Avoid constant 1-beat chase in breakdowns.

packs.name: Monument Markers
packs.focus: Monumental framing with controlled high-impact markers.
mover_ideas: Keep large framing routes stable through phrase bodies.
Trigger full-rig inclusion only on major phrase markers.
Use immediate post-marker simplification for readability.
par_ideas: Run 1-beat chase packets only at major markers.
Use 2-beat chase or fade between markers.
Reserve white-hit punctuation for structural moments.
anti_rules: Do not keep full-rig inclusion active for long sections.
Avoid frequent white-hit markers outside structural points.

packs.name: Macro Detail Contrast
packs.focus: Alternate macro architecture and micro detail focus.
mover_ideas: Run macro sweeps for 8 bars, then switch to detail targets.
Use detail bars to emphasize single-point trajectories.
Re-expand to macro shape at phrase transitions.
par_ideas: Use all-head chase in macro bars.
Switch to pair or split chases in detail bars.
Use fade bridges when moving between macro and detail modes.
anti_rules: Do not stay in detail mode for entire drops.
Avoid macro/detail flips faster than 4-bar windows.

packs.name: Fallback Resilience
packs.focus: Technically resilient patterning with graceful degradation.
mover_ideas: Use primary and fallback route options with equivalent intent.
Prefer mirrored transforms that survive fixture loss.
Reduce transform depth when density gets unstable.
par_ideas: Use chase patterns that can degrade from 4-head to 2-head cleanly.
Prefer 2-beat default chase with optional 1-beat accents.
Include predictable fade recovery bars after dense moments.
anti_rules: Do not depend on single-fixture gimmicks for core moments.
Avoid fragile one-shot sequences with no fallback state.

packs.name: Projection Coupled Geometry
packs.focus: Mover geometry that tracks projection language without visual conflict.
mover_ideas: Align route direction with projection line direction for 4-8 bar blocks.
Use mirror-hold punctuation to frame practical specials.
Switch to compressed geometry only at phrase transitions.
par_ideas: Keep PAR chase sparse while projection complexity is high.
Use 2-beat chase in groove bars and 4/8-beat fades in visual-reset bars.
Reserve 1-beat punctuation for projection dropout windows.
anti_rules: Do not run maximum projection motion and maximum mover motion at the same time.
Avoid dense PAR chase under intricate projection storytelling sections.

packs.name: Pod Wave Assault
packs.focus: Tilting pod wave energy with strict recovery pacing.
mover_ideas: Drive movers in directional wave packets lasting 1-2 bars.
Use alternating high-angle and low-angle wave ownership each bar.
Reset to a stable architecture immediately after dense wave bursts.
par_ideas: Run 1-beat chase attacks during wave peaks.
Use 2-beat chases on transition bars to hold momentum without overloading.
Insert 4-beat fade recovery bars after every 4-8 bars of heavy attack.
anti_rules: Do not keep high-intensity wave attacks active for entire drops.
Avoid stacking repeated white strobe waves without color recovery.

packs.name: Timing First Busk
packs.focus: Live timing intelligence over constant geometric mutation.
mover_ideas: Hold route families longer and vary timing/parity instead of position spam.
Use phrase edges for deliberate transform changes, not mid-phrase randomization.
Prioritize rhythmic clarity over fixture-count spectacle.
par_ideas: Run restrained fade worlds as the default in lower-energy phrases.
Use 2-beat chase inserts only when arrangement density increases.
Keep chase topology stable for at least 8 bars before rotating.
anti_rules: Do not force visual density increases when musical density is flat.
Avoid rapid route replacement that breaks live-busk readability.

packs.name: Distributed Brand Anchors
packs.focus: Repeat one iconic geometry across multiple stage planes.
mover_ideas: Duplicate one signature shape in center, wing, and audience-facing lanes.
Use mirrored anchor changes every 8 bars for controlled progression.
Expand anchor radius only at major phrase markers.
par_ideas: Contour chases should reinforce the selected shape boundary.
Use 2-beat chase for continuity and 1-beat hits only on anchor flips.
Use fade bars to reset before introducing a new anchor variant.
anti_rules: Do not introduce multiple unrelated hero shapes in one section.
Avoid frequent shape-family switches that dilute brand identity.

packs.name: Logo Frame Attack
packs.focus: Symmetric logo-frame architecture with audience attack windows.
mover_ideas: Keep movers inside a logo-derived frame and vary depth by bar.
Use pixel-rich fixtures for frame-edge acceleration in build phrases.
Snap to symmetric centerline on phrase downbeats for signature identity.
par_ideas: Use 1-beat chase bursts aimed down audience lanes during peaks.
Default to 2-beat chase around frame edges during groove sections.
Insert fade resets before major crowd-attack windows.
anti_rules: Do not break frame symmetry randomly inside phrase bodies.
Avoid continuous audience attack looks without stage-focused relief.

packs.name: Concentric Sun Matrix
packs.focus: Object-centric ring and matrix interplay for mover/PAR cohesion.
mover_ideas: Drive ring-based mover routes with clear clockwise/counterclockwise phases.
Use matrix intersection points as cue punctuation targets.
Change ring radius at phrase boundaries, not every bar.
par_ideas: Run arc-follow chases that trace ring edges.
Use 1-beat contour hits only when mover rings swap direction.
Use 4-beat fades during geometric reset bars.
anti_rules: Do not run unrelated linear chases against circular mover architecture.
Avoid radius changes that happen faster than one bar.

packs.name: Organic Beam Organism
packs.focus: Large mover arrays behaving as one evolving beam organism.
mover_ideas: Treat multi-fixture arrays as one macro object with phased sub-cells.
Use long-form phase evolution over 8-16 bars.
Apply only one major transform shift per phrase block.
par_ideas: Use restrained fade layers beneath beam-organism movement.
Apply short chase punctuation as phrase entry markers only.
Keep PAR movement simple when array complexity is high.
anti_rules: Do not split one-organism arrays into unrelated motion islands mid-phrase.
Avoid high-rate chase density while long-form organic sweeps are active.

packs.name: Strobe Wall Lead Voice
packs.focus: Strobe matrix as phrase-leading instrument with controlled returns.
mover_ideas: Hold architectural mover positions while strobe wall carries peak phrasing.
Use geometric re-entry moves directly after strobe climaxes.
Limit mover transform count during strobe-dominant bars.
par_ideas: Morph saturated PAR looks into strobe-led accents at phrase peaks.
Use short 1-beat strobe packets, then recover with 2/4-beat color chase.
Keep one color anchor active during strobe transitions for continuity.
anti_rules: Do not keep strobe-wall output at peak across entire sections.
Avoid dropping all color anchors during repeated strobe peaks.

packs.name: Winched Grid Morph
packs.focus: Lift/collapse grid reveals as phrase architecture markers.
mover_ideas: Use vertical depth changes to signal section transitions.
Run stable geometry while transitioning grid height.
Time morph endpoints to phrase downbeats for clean arrival.
par_ideas: Use ladder-step chase acceleration as grids move.
Switch to 4-beat fades on grid settle bars.
Use brief 1-beat punctuation at height-change completion points.
anti_rules: Do not trigger constant vertical morphs without settled groove bars.
Avoid mismatching lift timing and phrase boundaries.

packs.name: Four Cell Texture Engine
packs.focus: Cell-mode fixture programming for texture-rich variation.
mover_ideas: Partition fixture cells into alternating motion groups.
Rotate active cell groups every 4 bars to maintain novelty.
Use inverted cell ownership in contrast phrases.
par_ideas: Run cell-subset chases before full-fixture chases.
Use fade-based cell blooms in atmospheric sections.
Use 1-beat full-cell unison only for phrase punctuation.
anti_rules: Do not activate all cells at full density for long windows.
Avoid random cell remaps without barline alignment.

packs.name: Pyro Laser Windows
packs.focus: Lighting phrasing that leaves deliberate space for FX integration.
mover_ideas: Define pre-FX and post-FX lighting windows around key hits.
Use geometry holds immediately before pyro/laser impacts.
Resume route movement one beat after the FX hit for readability.
par_ideas: Reduce chase density in pre-FX bars to create contrast.
Use short beat-synced PAR blasts to frame FX hits.
Return to 2-beat chase during post-hit stabilization.
anti_rules: Do not mask pyro/laser moments with simultaneous maximum lighting chaos.
Avoid FX hits with no visual lead-in or release bars.

packs.name: Calibration Locked Geometry
packs.focus: Orientation-safe patterning for repeatable club/festival deployments.
mover_ideas: Build symmetric route templates that tolerate small rig variance.
Validate pan/tilt baselines before high-complexity layers.
Use mirrored correction bars at phrase starts.
par_ideas: Use standard diagnostic chase templates during transitions.
Default to 2/4-beat chases while alignment confidence is low.
Escalate to 1-beat patterns only after stable alignment bars.
anti_rules: Do not deploy asymmetric hero looks before verifying fixture orientation.
Avoid combining high-speed pan effects with uncertain focus alignment.

packs.name: Warm White Contrast Plate
packs.focus: Warm-white contrast anchors inside saturated RGB worlds.
mover_ideas: Keep saturated movement worlds, then insert short warm-white plate moments.
Use plate moments to reset visual fatigue before next color peak.
Tie plate timing to phrase boundaries every 8-16 bars.
par_ideas: Run RGB chase through phrase bodies and switch to warm-white hits on markers.
Use 1-beat warm plate accents followed by 2/4-beat color recovery.
Avoid extended warm-only states in high-energy sections.
anti_rules: Do not overuse warm-white plates until they lose contrast value.
Avoid abrupt warm/cool swaps without an intensity bridge.

packs.name: Universe Efficient Eye Candy
packs.focus: Channel-mode economy while preserving headline phrase detail.
mover_ideas: Assign detail-heavy transforms to hero fixtures only.
Keep support fixtures in lower-complexity mirrored behaviors.
Switch hero groups by phrase to spread detail ownership.
par_ideas: Run broad 2-beat chase on support PARs as baseline.
Inject 1-beat detail bursts through hero fixture subsets.
Use 4-beat fade resets after dense hero windows.
anti_rules: Do not run all fixtures at maximum channel complexity simultaneously.
Avoid hero detail bursts longer than phrase punctuation windows.

packs.name: Handoff Safe Matrix Architecture
packs.focus: Festival-grade architecture that supports rapid artist handoffs.
mover_ideas: Keep shared macro pages stable across all songs.
Layer artist-specific detail routes on top of macro templates.
Use one-bar neutral handoff buffers between detail families.
par_ideas: Maintain a shared baseline chase for all set segments.
Inject artist-specific chase deltas only in designated windows.
Return to baseline chase after each detail window for reliability.
anti_rules: Do not hide macro safety looks behind fragile per-artist pages.
Avoid abrupt look jumps with no neutral handoff frame.
